1.title:
Not a pro's tempo —
the tempo of your best swing
1.body:
Everyone has their own rhythm.
mytempo finds yours.

2.title:
Log the one swing
of your life
2.body:
One video of your swing
is all it takes to save your tempo.

3.title:
Practice that rhythm
back with sound
3.body:
Swing along to the sound
until it's second nature.

4.title:
Recommended tempo
isn't a goal
4.body:
A 3:1 ratio shows up again and again
in golfers' swings. It's a starting point,
not an answer — register your swing and it
switches to your own rhythm.

5.title:
How should we
light the screen?
5.body: Dark is easier at night or indoors.

shotInterval.title: Shot interval — rest time between swings
